description: Manage Google Contacts the way agents work: contact-shaped tools that finish in one call. Reads return flat contacts (plain emails/phones lists, one organization) instead of raw Person JSON; writes resolve etags and label names internally, so updating a contact or syncing a label's members never needs a lookup first.

inputs.description: Where the API is; it must be allowed below
inputs.name: api_base
inputs.title: API base URL

instructions: Find people with searchContacts (across all fields) or getContactByEmail (exact address; fails clearly on zero or several matches). Every contact read returns a shaped contact — plain emails/phones/address lists and one organization — never the raw People API shape. updateContact replaces whole fields: send the complete email/phone list you want to keep. The etag the API requires is resolved inside the connector. Labels resolve by name or resource name in every group tool; modifyGroupMembers adds and removes in one call and answers the new member count. Other contacts are Google's auto-collected addresses, separate from your contacts: list them with listOtherContacts, promote one with copyOtherContact. The Workspace directory is not covered (it needs an extra scope).
